page.layout: One column of running text on the right side of the page, with a narrow column of marginal notes in the left margin. Running head and page number at the top. Catchword at the lower right.
page.notes: The marginal note in the left margin is printed in small type; it is "Idem Hi-" / "ftor. libr." / "10.fol." / "mihi." / "191." and is transcribed with the long s written as s. The word "nihil" has a small ink blot over its first letter, read as "nihil". The word "Lancearia" is printed with a final character that is hard to read and may be "a". The catchword "prope" is printed alone at the right below the last line. Faint marks at the bottom right corner are a digitiser's watermark and were not transcribed.
